English: They reviewed available research on businesses and innovations in Ghana, and their impacts on the economy.

Zulu: Bathe umnotho waseGhana waba ngcono ngesikhathi beqala ukudayisa amafutha, ukhokho nezithelo, njengophayinaphu nomango, kwamanye amazwe emhlabeni jikelele.
Hausa: Sun ce tattalin arzikin ƙasar Ghana ya inganta lokacin da suka fara sayar da mai da koko da 'ya'yan itatuwa, kamar abarba da mangwaro ga sauran ƙasashen duniya.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore ekonomi ya Ghana e ile ya kaonafala ge ba thoma go rekiša oli, khoukhou le dikenywa, tša go swana le diphaeneapole le dimenko, ba rekišetša dinaga tše dingwe lefaseng ka bophara.
Amharic: የጋና ኢኮኖሚ የተሻሻለው ዘይት፣ ኮኮዋ እና እንደ አናናስ እና ማንጎ ያሉ ፍራፍሬዎችን ለሌሎች የዓለም ሃገራት መሸጥ ሲጀምሩ ነው ብለዋል።

English: Ghana made even more money selling its gold.
Luganda: Ghana yakola n’ensimbi nnyingi mu kutunda zzaabu waayo.
Yoruba: Orílẹ̀-èdè Ghana tilẹ̀ pa owó púpọ̀ síi nídìí tihta góòlù rẹ.
Zulu: IGhana yenza imali eyengeziwe ngokuthengisa igolide layo.
Hausa: Ƙasar Ghana ta ƙara samun kuɗi wajen sayar da zinarenta.
Northern Sotho: Ghana e ile ya dira tšhelete ye ntši ka go rekiša gauta ya yona.
Amharic: ጋና ወርቋን በመሸጥ የበለጠ ገንዘብ አገኘች።

English: The researchers said they expected the economy to continue growing since Ghana was expected to start selling wood from 2020.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti baasuubira ebyenfuna okwongera okukula enegri gye kiri nti Ghana yali esuubirwa okutandika okutunda embaawo okutandika n’omwaka gwa 2020.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé àwọn ń retí kí ọrọ̀ ajé náà ó máa gòkè síi níwọ̀n ìgbà tí orílè-èdè Ghana ń retí àti máa ta pákó láti ọdún 2020.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi balindele ukuthi umnotho uqhubeke nokukhula kwazise iGhana kulindeleke ukuthi iqale ukudayisa izinkuni kusukela ngo-2020.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce suna sa ran tattalin arzikin zai ci gaba da bunƙasa tun da ana san daga shekarar 2020 ƙasar Ghana za ta fara sayar da itace.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore ba emetše gore ekonomi ye e tšwele pele go gola ka ge Ghana e be e emetšwe go thoma go rekiša dikota go thoma ka 2020.
Amharic: ጋና ከ2020 ጀምሮ እንጨት መሸጥ ትጀምራለች ተብሎ ስለሚጠበቅ ኢኮኖሚዋ እያደገ ይሄዳል ብለው እንደሚጠብቁ ተመራማሪዎቹ ተናግረዋል።

English: They said the construction sector grew between 2015 and 2016, when the government built many buildings.
Luganda: Baagamba nti ekitongole ky’obuzimbi kyakulaakulana wakati w’omwaka gwa 2015 ne 2016, gavumenti bwe yazimba ebizimbe ebiwerako.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní ẹka ìkọ́lé gòkè láàrin ọdún 2015 àti ọdún 2016, nígbà tí ìjọba kọ́ àwọn ilé púpọ̀.
Zulu: Bathe umkhakha wezokwakha ukhulile phakathi kuwe-2015 nowe-2016, lapho uhulumeni akha izakhiwo eziningi.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce fannin gine-gine ya ƙaru a tsakanin shekarar 2015 zuwa shekar 2016, lokacin da gwamnati ta yi gine-gine da dama.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore lekala la kago le gotše magareng ga ngwaga wa 2015 le wa 2016, ge mmušo o be o aga meago ye mentši.
Amharic: በ2015 እና 2016 መካከል መንግስት ብዙ ህንፃዎችን በገነባበት ጊዜ የግንባታው ዘርፍ ማደጉን ተናግረዋል።

English: The researchers were however worried that the construction sector had grown more than the manufacturing sector, which was facing many challenges during that time and experienced less production.
Luganda: Wabula abanoonyereza baali beeraliikirivu nti ekitongole ky’obuzimbi kyali kikuze nnyo okusinga ekitongole ekikola ebintu, ekyalina okusoomooza okungi mu kiseera ekyo era nga kyali kifulumya ebintu bitono.
Yoruba: Ominú wá ń kọ àwọn aṣèwádìí náà pé ẹ̀ka ìṣẹ́ ṣíṣe ti gògè ju ẹ̀ka ìṣe amùṣẹ́ṣe lọ, tí ó ń kojú ìpèníjà púpọ̀ ní àsìkò náà tí ó sì ń ní ìrírí ìpèsè tí ókéré.
Zulu: Abacwaningi nokho babekhathazekile ngokuthi umkhakha wezokwakha usukhule kakhulu kunomkhakha wezokukhiqiza, owawubhekene nezinselelo eziningi ngaleso sikhathi futhi wathola ukukhiqizwa okuncane.
Hausa: Duk da haka, masu binciken sun damu da cewa fannin gine-gine ya bunƙasa fiye da ɓangaren masana'antu, wanda yake fuskantar ƙalubaloli da yawa a lokacin da kuma rashin samar da kayayyaki.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go be go le bjale banyakišiši ba be ba tshwenyega gore lekala la kago le ghotše go feta lekala la botšweletši, leo le bego le lebane le ditlhohlo tše ntši ka nako yeo gomme la itemogela tšweletšo ye nnyane.
Amharic: በዚያን ጊዜ ብዙ ፈተናዎች ከገጠሙት እና አነስተኛ ምርት ካጋጠመው የማምረት ዘርፍ በላይ የግንባታ ዘርፉ ማደጉ ግን ተመራማሪዎቹን አሳስቧቸዋል።

English: Even though construction also created jobs, it should not be at the expense of the manufacturing that produces goods to sell.
Luganda: Newankubadde ng’obuzimbi nabwo bwatondawo emirimu, tebulina kubuutikira kitongole ekikola ebintu eby’okutunda.
Yoruba: Bí ó ti lẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ẹ̀ka amúṣẹ́ṣe náà ń pèsè iṣẹ́, kò gbọdọ̀ jémímú ṣaájú pípèsè àwọn ọjà láti tà.
Zulu: Nakuba ezokwakha nazo zidale amathuba emisebenzi, akumele kube yizindleko zokukhiqiza okukhiqiza izimpahla ezizothengiswa.
Hausa: Duk da cewa gine-gine ma sun samar da ayyukan yi, bai kamata ya zama asara ga masana'antun da suke samar da kayayyaki domin sayarwa ba.
Northern Sotho: Le ge e le gore lekala la kago le lona le hlomile mešomo, ga se la swanela go hloma mešomo ka go phuhlamiša la botšweletši leo le tšweletšago dithoto tšeo di rekišwago.
Amharic: ግንባታው የስራ እድል ቢፈጥርም የሚሸጡ ዕቃዎችን የሚያመርተውን የማምረት ዘርፍ በሚጎዳ መልኩ መሆን የለበትም።

English: The researchers said if prices of goods in the country continue increasing, or if the government borrowed more money from outside, or if less foreigners came to do business in Ghana, the country’s economy might collapse.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti singa ebisale by’ebintu mu ggwanga byongera okulinnya, oba singa gavumenti ebeera nga yeewola ensimbi eziwerako mu mawanga ag’ebweru, oba singa abagwira batono abajja okukola bizineesi mu ggwanga lya Ghana, ebyenfuna by’eggwanga biyinza okugwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣẹ̀wádìí sọ pé tí iye owó ọjà ní orílẹ̀-èdè náà bá bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní lé síi, tàbí tí ìjọba náà bá yá owó síi láti ìta, tàbí tí àwọn ará ilẹ̀ òkèrè níye ni ó wá ṣe òwò ní orílẹ̀-èdè Ghana, ọrọ̀-ajé orílẹ̀-èdè náà lè wó.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe uma amanani ezimpahla ezweni eqhubeka nokunyuka, noma uma uhulumeni eboleka imali eyengeziwe ngaphandle, noma uma abantu bangaphandle abancane beza ukuzokwenza ibhizinisi eGhana, umnotho wezwe ungase ubhidlike.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce idan har farashin kayayyaki ya ci gaba da ƙaruwa a ƙasar, ko kuma idan gwamnati ta karɓi rancen kuɗi daga waje, ko kuma idan baƙi kaɗan ne suka zo yin kasuwanci a ƙasar Ghana, tattalin arzikin ƙasar yana iya durƙushewa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore ge ditheko tša dithoto ka mo nageng di tšwela pele go hlatloga, goba ge mmušo o adima tšhelete ye ntši go tšwa dinageng tša ka ntle, goba ge batšwantle ba bannyane ba etla go dira kgwebo ka Ghana, ekonomi ya ka mo nageng ye e ka phuhlama.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በሃገሪቱ ውስጥ የሸቀጦች ዋጋ እየጨመረ ቢሄድ ወይም መንግስት ከውጭ ብዙ ገንዘብ ቢበደር ወይም ጋና ለንግድ የሚመጡ የውጭ ዜጎችን ብዛት ቢቀንስ የሃገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚ ሊወድቅ ይችላል ብለዋል።

English: These researchers said businesses and innovation are as important for economies of developing countries as they are for rich, developed countries.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti bizineesi n’obuyiiya bya muwendo eri ebyenfuna by’amawanga agakyakula nga bwe biri eri amawanga amagagga agaakula edda.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé oko-òwò àti ohun tuntun ṣe pàtàkì sí ọrọ̀-ajé àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ìdàgbàsókè ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ń bá, àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ìdàgbàsókè ti bá ni ó sì wà fún.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi bathe amabhizinisi nokusungulwa kwezinto kubalulekile emnothweni wamazwe asathuthuka njengoba kubalulekile emazweni acebile nathuthukile.
Hausa: Waɗannan masu binciken sun ce kasuwanci da ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire suna da matuƙar muhimmanci ga tattalin arzikin ƙasashe masu tasowa kamar yadda suke da mawadata, waɗanda suka ci gaba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ba boletše gore dikgwebo le boitlhamelo di bohlokwa go swana le diekonomi tša dinaga tšeo di sa hlabologago go swana le ga dinaga tše di humilego tšeo di hlabologilego.
Amharic: እነዚህ ተመራማሪዎች ንግዶች እና ፈጠራዎች ለበለጸጉ እና ላደጉ ሃገራት ጠቃሚ እንደሆኑት ሁሉ ለታዳጊ ሃገራት ኢኮኖሚዎችም እንዲሁ ጠቃሚ ናቸው ብለዋል።

English: They recommended that the government should work with other stakeholders to grow and support businesses and innovation in Ghana.
Luganda: Baateesa nti gavumenti esaanye ekolagane n’abantu abalala be kikwatako okukulaakulanya n’okuwanirira bizineesi n’obuyiiya mu ggwanga lya Ghana.
Yoruba: Wọ́n dáa lábàá pé kí ìjọba ó ṣiṣẹ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn alẹ́nulọ́rọ̀ láti mú ìdàgbàsókè àti láti ṣe àtìlẹ́yìn oko-òwò àti ohun tuntun ní orílẹ̀-èdè Ghana.
Zulu: Baphakamise ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele asebenzisane nabanye ababambiqhaza ukukhulisa nokweseka amabhizinisi kanye nokusungula eGhana.
Hausa: Sun bayar da shawarar cewa ya kamata gwamnati ta yi aiki tare da sauran masu ruwa da tsaki domin bunƙasawa da kuma tallafawa kasuwanci da ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire a ƙasarGhana.
Northern Sotho: Ba šišinya gore mmušo o swanetše go šoma le batšeakarolo ba bangwe go godiša le go thekga dikgwebo le boitlhamelo ka Ghana.
Amharic: በጋና ንግዶችን እና ፈጠራን ለማሳደግ እና ለመደገፍ መንግስት ከሌሎች ባለድርሻ አካላት ጋር መስራት እንዳለበት አሳስበዋል።
